title: Pul, narx va savdolashish
goal_uz: Dars oxirida katta sonlar va narxlarni to‘g‘ri o‘qiysiz, chegirma va qaytim haqida gapirasiz, naqd yoki karta bilan to‘laysiz va bozorda muloyim savdolashib kelishuvga erisha olasiz.

scenes.title: Pul, narx va savdolashish
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Yigirma birinchi darsga xush kelibsiz. O‘tgan darsda kino, musiqa va kitoblar haqida gaplashdik, fikr bildirdik va tavsiya berdik. Bugun hayotda har kuni kerak bo‘ladigan mavzu: pul, narx va savdolashish. Siz katta sonlarni o‘qiysiz, narxni so‘raysiz, chegirma va qaytimni tushuntirasiz, naqd yoki karta bilan to‘laysiz va bozorda muloyim savdolashasiz.
scenes.say: Hello again! Today we talk about money, prices and bargaining. You will ask for prices, pay and negotiate in English.
scenes.say_uz: Yana salom! Bugun pul, narx va savdolashish haqida gaplashamiz. Narx so‘raysiz, to‘laysiz va ingliz tilida kelishasiz.

scenes.title: Valyutalar
scenes.say_native: Valyuta ingliz tilida “currency”. Britaniyada pul birligi “pound”, ya’ni funt, uning mayda puli “penny”, ko‘plikda “pence”. AQSHda “dollar” va “cent”. Yevropada “euro”. O‘zbekiston puli “som”, ingliz tilida “the Uzbek som”. Muhim: son bir dan katta bo‘lsa, valyutaga ko‘plik qo‘shamiz: “five pounds”, “ten dollars”. Lekin “som” odatda o‘zgarmaydi: “five thousand som”.
scenes.say: Pounds and pence. Dollars and cents. Euros. Uzbek som. It costs five pounds. The ticket is ten dollars.
scenes.say_uz: Funt va pens. Dollar va sent. Yevro. O‘zbek so‘mi. Narxi besh funt. Chipta o‘n dollar.

scenes.title: Katta sonlar

examples.t: It costs two hundred and fifty pounds.
examples.uz: Uning narxi ikki yuz ellik funt.

examples.t: The car is fifteen thousand dollars.

scenes.say_native: Katta sonlarni o‘rganamiz. Yuz — “hundred”, ming — “thousand”, million — “million”. Britaniya inglizchasida yuzlikdan keyin “and” aytiladi: 250 — “two hundred and fifty”. Amerikaliklar ko‘pincha “and” ni tushirib qoldiradi. Mingliklarni vergul bilan yozamiz: 1,000, 15,000, 1,000,000. O‘zbekchada esa ko‘pincha bo‘sh joy ishlatamiz. Ingliz tilida kasr nuqta bilan yoziladi: 4.50.
scenes.say: A hundred. A thousand. A million. Two hundred and fifty. Fifteen thousand. Three million.
scenes.say_uz: Yuz. Ming. Million. Ikki yuz ellik. O‘n besh ming. Uch million.

scenes.title: Narxni o‘qish
scenes.say_native: Narxni o‘qiganda odatda “pound” va “pence” so‘zlarini to‘liq aytmaymiz. 4.50 funtni “four pounds fifty” deymiz, ya’ni oxirgi qismdagi “pence” tushiriladi. 2.99 dollarni tez nutqda “two ninety-nine” deyish mumkin. Faqat pens bo‘lsa, “p” deymiz: “seventy-five p”, ya’ni 75 pens. Katta narxlarni esa oddiy sonlar kabi o‘qiymiz: “forty-five thousand som”.
scenes.say: Four pounds fifty. Two ninety-nine. Seventy-five pence. Forty-five thousand som.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt funt ellik. Ikki to‘qson to‘qqiz. Yetmish besh pens. Qirq besh ming so‘m.

scenes.title: Son va ming
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida “ikki ming” deymiz va “ming” o‘zgarmaydi. Ammo ba’zi o‘quvchilar ingliz tilida “two thousands” deb xato qiladi. Qoida: “hundred”, “thousand”, “million” aniq son bilan kelsa, ko‘plik “-s” olmaydi: “two thousand”, “five hundred”, “three million”. Faqat noaniq miqdorda “-s” bo‘ladi: “thousands of people”, ya’ni minglab odamlar. Shuning uchun narxda doim birlik shaklini ishlating.
scenes.say: Two thousand pounds. Five hundred dollars. Three million people. Thousands of people.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki ming funt. Besh yuz dollar. Uch million odam. Minglab odamlar.

scenes.title: Sonlarni ayting
scenes.say_native: Beshta narxni baland ovozda ayting. Birinchi: 250. Ikkinchi: 1,500. Uchinchi: 4 funt 50 pens. To‘rtinchi: 3,000,000. Beshinchi: 75 pens. Britaniya variantida yuzlikdan keyin “and” ni qo‘yishni unutmang. Sekin boshlang, keyin tezlashtiring.
scenes.say: Say these prices: two hundred and fifty, one thousand five hundred, four pounds fifty, three million, seventy-five pence.
scenes.say_uz: Bu narxlarni ayting: ikki yuz ellik, bir ming besh yuz, to‘rt funt ellik, uch million, yetmish besh pens.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. 250 — “two hundred and fifty”. 1,500 — “one thousand, five hundred”, amerikaliklar ko‘pincha “fifteen hundred” ham deyishadi. 4.50 — “four pounds fifty”. 3,000,000 — “three million”, “s” siz. 75p — “seventy-five pence”. Agar hammasini to‘g‘ri aytgan bo‘lsangiz, narxlarni tushunishda sizga hech narsa xalaqit bermaydi. Bu ko‘nikma bozorda ham, internetda ham kerak.
scenes.say: Two hundred and fifty. One thousand, five hundred. Four pounds fifty. Three million. Seventy-five pence.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki yuz ellik. Bir ming besh yuz. To‘rt funt ellik. Uch million. Yetmish besh pens.

scenes.title: Narxni so‘rash
board: How much is it? / How much are they?
scenes.say_native: Narxni so‘rashning asosiy shakli — “How much is it?” Bitta narsa bo‘lsa “is”, ko‘plik bo‘lsa “are”: “How much are these shoes?” Boshqa variant — “How much does it cost?” Javobda “It costs” yoki “They cost”. Aytganda “this” yaqindagi bitta narsa, “these” esa yaqindagi bir nechta narsa uchun. Bu o‘zbekchadagi “bu qancha?” savolidan farq qilmaydi, faqat shaklni moslashtirish kerak.
scenes.say: How much is this scarf? It costs eight pounds. How much are these shoes? They cost forty pounds.
scenes.say_uz: Bu sharf qancha turadi? Uning narxi sakkiz funt. Bu poyabzal qancha turadi? Uning narxi qirq funt.

scenes.title: Qimmat va arzon
scenes.say_native: Narx haqida gapirish uchun sifatlar. “Expensive” — qimmat, “cheap” — arzon. Lekin ehtiyot bo‘ling: “cheap” ba’zan sifatsiz degan ma’noni ham beradi. Yaxshi, ammo arzon narsa uchun “reasonable” yoki “good value” deyiladi. “Too expensive” — me’yordan qimmat, ya’ni sotib ololmayman degani. “Very” bilan farqi: “very expensive” faqat qimmat, “too expensive” esa muammo.
scenes.say: This is expensive. That one is cheap. It's too expensive for me. This price is reasonable.
scenes.say_uz: Bu qimmat. U arzon. U men uchun juda qimmat. Bu narx maqbul.

scenes.title: Narx qimmat bo‘lmaydi
board: ✓ The price is high. / It is expensive.
scenes.say_native: O‘zbekchada “narxi qimmat” deymiz, shuning uchun ingliz tilida “the price is expensive” deb xato qilamiz. Ingliz tilida narxning o‘zi “high” yoki “low” bo‘ladi, narsaning o‘zi esa “expensive” yoki “cheap”. “The price is high” yoki “The shoes are expensive”. Ikkinchi xato — “very much expensive”. Sifat oldidan “very” kerak: “very expensive”. “Much” sifat oldida ishlatilmaydi.
scenes.say: The shoes are expensive. The price is high. It is very expensive. It is too expensive.
scenes.say_uz: Poyabzal qimmat. Narx baland. U juda qimmat. U haddan tashqari qimmat.

scenes.title: Chegirma
scenes.say_native: Chegirma ingliz tilida “discount”. Do‘konda “sale” yozuvi bo‘lsa, chegirmalar bor. “On sale” — chegirmada. “Twenty percent off” — yigirma foiz arzon. “Half price” — yarim narx. “Buy one, get one free” — bittasini ol, ikkinchisi tekin. Chegirma so‘rash uchun: “Is there a discount?” Ba’zi do‘konlarda o‘quvchilar uchun maxsus chegirma bo‘ladi, shuning uchun “student discount” haqida so‘rash foydali.
scenes.say: Is there a discount? These coats are on sale. They are twenty percent off. This one is half price.
scenes.say_uz: Chegirma bormi? Bu paltolar chegirmada. Ular yigirma foiz arzon. Bu yarim narxda.

scenes.title: Qaytim va mayda pul
board: Keep the change.  ·  Do you have change for £20?

examples.t: Do you have change for twenty pounds?

scenes.say_native: “Change” ikki ma’noga ega: qaytim va mayda pul. Sotuvchi sizga “Here’s your change” desa, qaytimni beryapti. “Keep the change” — qaytimni oling, qolsin. “Do you have change for twenty pounds?” — yigirma funtni maydalab bera olasizmi? Qog‘oz pul — Britaniyada “note”, AQSHda “bill”, tanga esa “coin”. “Change” sanalmaydigan ot, shuning uchun “a change” demaymiz, “some change” deymiz.
scenes.say: Here is your change. Keep the change. Do you have change for twenty pounds? A five-pound note. A one-pound coin.
scenes.say_uz: Mana qaytimingiz. Qaytimi qolsin. Yigirma funtga mayda pulingiz bormi? Besh funtlik qog‘oz pul. Bir funtlik tanga.

scenes.title: Hisoblab ayting
scenes.say_native: Uchta hisob. Birinchi: qahvaning narxi 3 funt 20 pens, siz 5 funt berdingiz. Qaytim qancha? Ikkinchi: palto 40 funt, 25 foiz chegirma. Yangi narx qancha? Uchinchi: ikkita kitob, har biri 7 funt 50 pens. Jami qancha? Javoblarni inglizcha aytib bering.
scenes.say: A coffee is three pounds twenty. You give five pounds. What is the change? A coat is forty pounds and it is twenty-five percent off. What is the new price? Two books are seven pounds fifty each. What is the total?
scenes.say_uz: Qahva uch funt yigirma pens. Siz besh funt berasiz. Qaytim qancha? Palto qirq funt va yigirma besh foiz arzon. Yangi narx qancha? Ikki kitob har biri yetti funt ellik pens. Jami qancha?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: 5 dan 3.20 ni ayirsak, 1.80 qoladi, “one pound eighty”. Ikkinchi: 40 funtning chorak qismi 10 funt, 40 dan 10 ni ayirsak, 30 funt: “thirty pounds”. Uchinchi: 7.50 ikki marta 15 funt, “fifteen pounds”. Agar hisobni va inglizcha aytishni birga qila olgan bo‘lsangiz, bu juda yaxshi natija. Xaridda aynan shunday tezkor hisob kerak bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: One pound eighty. Thirty pounds. Fifteen pounds.
scenes.say_uz: Bir funt sakson. O‘ttiz funt. O‘n besh funt.

scenes.title: Birinchi dialog: do‘konda
board: A: How much is this jacket?
B: It's sixty pounds, but it's on sale.
A: Great! Can I pay by card?
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialog do‘konda. Mijoz kurtka narxini so‘raydi, sotuvchi chegirma borligini aytadi, mijoz to‘lov usulini so‘raydi. Tinglang va ikkita narsani eslab qoling: kurtkaning dastlabki narxi va chegirmadan keyingi narxi. Diqqat bilan eshiting, raqamlar tez aytiladi.
scenes.say: Customer: Excuse me, how much is this jacket? Seller: It's sixty pounds, but it's on sale today. It's twenty percent off. Customer: So how much is it now? Seller: Forty-eight pounds. Customer: Great, I'll take it. Can I pay by card? Seller: Of course. Do you need a bag? Customer: No, thanks. Seller: Here is your receipt.
scenes.say_uz: Mijoz: Kechirasiz, bu kurtka qancha? Sotuvchi: Oltmish funt, lekin bugun chegirmada. Yigirma foiz arzon. Mijoz: Unda hozir qancha? Sotuvchi: Qirq sakkiz funt. Mijoz: Ajoyib, men uni olaman. Karta bilan to‘lasam bo‘ladimi? Sotuvchi: Albatta. Paket kerakmi? Mijoz: Yo‘q, rahmat. Sotuvchi: Mana chekingiz.

scenes.title: Savollar
board: 1) How much was the jacket before?
3) Does the customer take a bag?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: kurtka avval qancha turgan? Ikkinchi: hozir narxi qancha? Uchinchi: mijoz paketni oladimi? Eslab ko‘ring: sotuvchi qanday foiz chegirma aytdi? Javoblarni inglizcha va to‘liq gap bilan ayting.
scenes.say: How much was the jacket before? What is the price now? Does the customer take a bag?
scenes.say_uz: Kurtka avval qancha edi? Hozir narxi qancha? Mijoz paketni oladimi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 3) No, she does not take a bag.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: kurtka avval oltmish funt edi. Ikkinchi: yigirma foiz chegirmadan keyin qirq sakkiz funt. Tekshirib ko‘ring: oltmishning yigirma foizi o‘n ikki, oltmishdan o‘n ikkini ayirsak, qirq sakkiz. Uchinchi: yo‘q, mijoz paketni olmaydi, u “No, thanks” dedi. Bu yerda “receipt” so‘zini ham eslab qoling: u chek degani va “receipt” da “p” aytilmaydi: ri-SIT.
scenes.say: It was sixty pounds. It is forty-eight pounds now. No, the customer does not take a bag.
scenes.say_uz: U oltmish funt edi. Hozir qirq sakkiz funt. Yo‘q, mijoz paket olmaydi.

scenes.title: Naqd yoki karta
board: pay in cash / pay by card
scenes.say_native: To‘lov usullari. Naqd to‘lash — “pay in cash” yoki oddiy “pay cash”. Karta bilan — “pay by card”. Esda tuting, bu yerda “the” yoki “a” kerak emas: “by card”, “by bank transfer”. “Contactless” — kartani terminalga tekkizib to‘lash, “PIN” — to‘rt raqamli maxfiy kod, “receipt” — chek. Savol: “Cash or card?” — naqdmi yoki kartami? Va javob: “Card, please”.
scenes.say: Cash or card? Card, please. I'll pay in cash. Can I pay by card? Do you need a receipt?
scenes.say_uz: Naqdmi yoki karta? Karta, iltimos. Men naqd to‘layman. Karta bilan to‘lasam bo‘ladimi? Chek kerakmi?

scenes.title: To‘lov predloglari
scenes.say_native: O‘zbekchada “karta bilan” va “naqd pulga” deymiz, shuning uchun ingliz tilida predloglar chalkashadi. Qoida oddiy: karta uchun “by card”, naqd uchun “in cash”. Aralashtirmang: “by cash” noto‘g‘ri. “With a card” aslida to‘g‘ri bo‘lishi mumkin, masalan, “I paid with my card”, lekin “by card” tabiiyroq va qisqa. Ikkala holatda ham artikl yo‘q. Mana shu ikki ibora yetarli.
scenes.say: I pay by card. I pay in cash. I paid by card yesterday.
scenes.say_uz: Men karta bilan to‘layman. Men naqd to‘layman. Kecha karta bilan to‘ladim.

scenes.title: Kassada
board: Tap your card. / Enter your PIN.
Would you like a bag? · Here's your receipt.
scenes.say_native: Kassada sotuvchi aytadigan gaplarni bilish kerak. “That’s twelve pounds forty, please” — jami 12 funt 40 pens. “Tap your card” — kartani tekkizing. “Enter your PIN” — kodni kiriting. “Would you like a bag?” — paket kerakmi? “Do you want to keep the receipt?” — chekni olasizmi? Javob berish oson: “Yes, please” yoki “No, thanks”. Bu muloyim shakl, shuning uchun sizni yaxshi mijoz deb bilishadi.
scenes.say: That's twelve pounds forty, please. Tap your card. Would you like a bag? No, thanks. Here's your receipt.
scenes.say_uz: Jami o‘n ikki funt qirq pens, iltimos. Kartangizni tekkizing. Paket kerakmi? Yo‘q, rahmat. Mana chekingiz.

scenes.title: Nima deysiz?
board: 1) You want to pay by card.
scenes.say_native: Uchta vaziyat. Birinchi: karta bilan to‘lamoqchisiz. Ikkinchi: yigirma funtga mayda pul kerak. Uchinchi: chek olmoqchisiz. Har biri uchun muloyim gap tuzing. Eslang: so‘rashda “Can I...?” yoki “Do you have...?” ishlatamiz.
scenes.say: You want to pay by card. You need change for twenty pounds. You want a receipt. What do you say?
scenes.say_uz: Karta bilan to‘lamoqchisiz. Yigirma funtga mayda pul kerak. Chek olmoqchisiz. Nima deysiz?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 2) Do you have change for twenty pounds?
3) Can I have a receipt, please?
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “Can I pay by card?” Ikkinchi: “Do you have change for twenty pounds?” Uchinchi: “Can I have a receipt, please?” Hammasida “please” yoki savol shakli muloyimlikni beradi. “Give me a receipt” desangiz, buyruq kabi eshitiladi, shuning uchun “Can I have...” ni ishlating. Bu qoida do‘konda ham, restoranda ham ishlaydi.
scenes.say: Can I pay by card? Do you have change for twenty pounds? Can I have a receipt, please?
scenes.say_uz: Karta bilan to‘lasam bo‘ladimi? Yigirma funtga mayda pulingiz bormi? Chek olsam bo‘ladimi, iltimos?

scenes.title: Savdolashish madaniyati
board: Markets, second-hand, street stalls: you can bargain
scenes.say_native: Savdolashish madaniyati har joyda har xil. O‘zbekistonda bozorda savdolashish odatiy hol. Britaniyada esa katta do‘konlar va supermarketlarda narxlar qat’iy, u yerda savdolashmaymiz. Savdolashish asosan bozorlarda, ishlatilgan buyumlar sotuvida, ko‘cha rastalarida va ba’zi sayyohlik joylarida bo‘lishi mumkin. Asosiy qoida: tabassum bilan, hurmat bilan, bosim qilmasdan. Agar sotuvchi rad etsa, xafa bo‘lmang.
scenes.say: In big shops, prices are fixed. At markets, you can often bargain. Be polite and smile.
scenes.say_uz: Katta do‘konlarda narxlar qat’iy. Bozorlarda ko‘pincha savdolashish mumkin. Muloyim bo‘ling va tabassum qiling.

scenes.title: Mijoz iboralari
board: Can you give me a discount?

examples.t: Can you do it for fifteen pounds?

scenes.say_native: Savdolashish iboralarini o‘rganamiz. Avval narxga munosabat: “That’s a bit expensive” — bu biroz qimmat. Keyin taklif: “Can you do it for fifteen pounds?” — o‘n besh funtga bera olasizmi? Yoki “What’s your best price?” — eng yaxshi narxingiz qancha? Chegirma so‘rash: “Can you give me a discount?” Tezda “It’s too expensive” deb rad qilishdan ko‘ra, “a bit expensive” yumshoqroq va muloyimroq eshitiladi.
scenes.say: That's a bit expensive. Can you do it for fifteen pounds? What's your best price? Can you give me a discount?
scenes.say_uz: Bu biroz qimmat. O‘n besh funtga bera olasizmi? Eng yaxshi narxingiz qancha? Chegirma qila olasizmi?

scenes.title: Sotuvchi iboralari

examples.t: I can do eighteen pounds for you.
examples.uz: Siz uchun o‘n sakkiz funtga bera olaman.

scenes.say_native: Sotuvchi nima deyishi mumkin? “It’s a good price” — narx yaxshi. “I can do eighteen pounds” — o‘n sakkiz funtga bera olaman. “That’s my last price” yoki “final price” — oxirgi narx, boshqa tushmaydi. Kelishilganda ikkala tomon “OK, deal!” deydi, ya’ni “Mayli, kelishdik!” Agar narxingiz to‘g‘ri kelmasa, “No, thank you” deb ketishingiz ham mumkin. Bu savdolashishning normal qismi.
scenes.say: It's a good price. I can do eighteen pounds. That's my last price. OK, deal!
scenes.say_uz: Narx yaxshi. Men o‘n sakkiz funtga bera olaman. Bu mening oxirgi narxim. Mayli, kelishdik!

scenes.title: Muloyimlik va so‘z tartibi
board: ✓ Can you give me a discount?
✓ That's too expensive. / That's a bit expensive.
scenes.say_native: Ikkita xato. Birinchisi: “Give me discount!” — bu buyruq va artikl ham yo‘q. Muloyim variant: “Can you give me a discount?” Savdolashishda ham muloyimlik muhim, aks holda sotuvchi sizga kamroq yon beradi. Ikkinchisi: “too much expensive”. “Too” va “much” birga ishlatilmaydi. To‘g‘risi: “too expensive”. Agar aniq yordam so‘ramoqchi bo‘lsangiz, “much” ni “too much” sifatida faqat ot bilan ishlating: “too much money”.
scenes.say: Can you give me a discount? That's too expensive. That's a bit expensive.
scenes.say_uz: Chegirma qila olasizmi? Bu haddan tashqari qimmat. Bu biroz qimmat.

scenes.title: Savdolashing
scenes.say_native: Siz bozordasiz. Sharf yigirma funt turadi, siz esa o‘n besh funt to‘lamoqchisiz. Uchta gap ayting: birinchi, narxga munosabat bildiring; ikkinchi, o‘z narxingizni taklif qiling; uchinchi, sotuvchi roziligiga javob bering. Hammasi muloyim bo‘lsin va “please” yoki “can you” ni ishlating.
scenes.say: A scarf is twenty pounds. You want to pay fifteen. React to the price, make an offer, and answer the seller.
scenes.say_uz: Sharf yigirma funt. Siz o‘n besh funt to‘lamoqchisiz. Narxga munosabat bildiring, taklif qiling va sotuvchiga javob bering.

scenes.title: Namuna savdolashuv
board: Can you do it for fifteen pounds?
scenes.say_native: Namuna: “That’s a bit expensive.” Keyin: “Can you do it for fifteen pounds?” Sotuvchi: “I can do eighteen.” Siz: “Can you do seventeen?” Sotuvchi: “OK, seventeen.” Siz: “Deal! Thank you.” Ko‘rdingizmi, har qadamda tabassum, “please” va “thank you” bor. O‘rtadagi narx, 17 funt, ikkala tomon uchun ham qulay. Bunday qadam-baqadam yondashuv savdolashishni tabiiy qiladi.
scenes.say: That's a bit expensive. Can you do it for fifteen pounds? I can do eighteen. Can you do seventeen? OK, deal! Thank you.
scenes.say_uz: Bu biroz qimmat. O‘n besh funtga bera olasizmi? O‘n sakkizga bera olaman. O‘n yettiga bera olasizmi? Mayli, kelishdik! Rahmat.

scenes.title: Ikkinchi dialog: bozorda
board: A: How much are these bowls?
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog bozorda. Turist sotuvchidan sopol kosalarning narxini so‘raydi, savdolashadi va oxirida kelishishadi. Tinglash vazifasi: kosaning dastlabki narxi, turist taklif qilgan narx va yakuniy kelishuvni toping. Raqamlarga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Tourist: Excuse me, how much are these bowls? Seller: Twelve pounds each. Tourist: That's a bit expensive. Can you do ten? Seller: Ten for one, but if you buy two, I can do eighteen. Tourist: Hmm, eighteen for two. OK, deal! Seller: Wonderful. Cash or card? Tourist: Cash. Here is a twenty-pound note. Seller: And here's two pounds change.
scenes.say_uz: Turist: Kechirasiz, bu kosalar qancha? Sotuvchi: Har biri o‘n ikki funt. Turist: Bu biroz qimmat. O‘nga bera olasizmi? Sotuvchi: Bittasi o‘nga, lekin ikkita olsangiz, o‘n sakkizga bera olaman. Turist: Mm, ikkitasi o‘n sakkiz. Mayli, kelishdik! Sotuvchi: Ajoyib. Naqdmi yoki karta? Turist: Naqd. Mana yigirma funtlik. Sotuvchi: Mana ikki funt qaytim.

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring
board: 1) How much is one bowl at first?
2) What is the price for two?
3) How does the tourist pay? Change?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: bitta kosa dastlab qancha? Ikkinchi: ikkita kosaning kelishilgan narxi qancha? Uchinchi: turist qanday to‘laydi va qaytim qancha? Esda tuting, turist yigirma funtlik bergan. Javoblarni to‘liq gap bilan ayting.
scenes.say: How much is one bowl at first? What is the price for two bowls? How does the tourist pay, and how much is the change?
scenes.say_uz: Bitta kosa avval qancha? Ikkita kosaning narxi qancha? Turist qanday to‘laydi va qaytim qancha?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: dastlab bitta kosa o‘n ikki funt. Ikkinchi: ikkitasi o‘n sakkiz funt, ya’ni bittasi to‘qqiz funt, bu yaxshi chegirma. Uchinchi: turist naqd to‘laydi, yigirma funt beradi, o‘n sakkiz funt to‘laydi va ikki funt qaytim oladi. Sotuvchi yaxshi savdo qildi: ko‘proq sotdi, mijoz esa arzonroq oldi. Savdolashishning maqsadi shu.
scenes.say: Twelve pounds. Eighteen pounds for two. In cash, and the change is two pounds.
scenes.say_uz: O‘n ikki funt. Ikkitasi uchun o‘n sakkiz funt. Naqd, qaytim ikki funt.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: thirteen va thirty
scenes.say_native: Pulda xato qilmaslik uchun bir juft sonni farqlash kerak. “-teen” bilan tugaydigan sonlarda urg‘u oxirgi bo‘g‘inda: thirTEEN, fourTEEN, fifTEEN, va “-teen” cho‘ziq aytiladi. “-ty” bilan tugaydigan sonlarda urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda: THIRty, FORty, FIFty, oxirgi tovush qisqa. Shuning uchun 15 funt bilan 50 funt orasidagi farq katta. Mijoz va sotuvchi shu farq tufayli bir-birini tushunadi.
scenes.say: Thirteen. Thirty. Fourteen. Forty. Fifteen. Fifty.
scenes.say_uz: O‘n uch. O‘ttiz. O‘n to‘rt. Qirq. O‘n besh. Ellik.

scenes.title: Qaysi son?
scenes.say_native: Men juftliklarni aytaman, siz qaysi biri ekanini eshitib toping. Birinchi: sixteen pounds. Ikkinchi: ninety pounds. Uchinchi: fourteen pounds. Har safar urg‘uga quloq soling: oxirida kuchli bo‘lsa, o‘n bilan boshlanadigan son, boshida bo‘lsa, o‘nlik. Keyin o‘zingiz ham ikkala sonni to‘g‘ri aytib ko‘ring.
scenes.say: Listen and choose. One: sixteen pounds. Two: ninety pounds. Three: fourteen pounds.
scenes.say_uz: Eshiting va tanlang. Bir: o‘n olti funt. Ikki: to‘qson funt. Uch: o‘n to‘rt funt.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchisi — sixteen, ya’ni 16 funt, chunki urg‘u oxirgi bo‘g‘inda. Ikkinchisi — ninety, ya’ni 90 funt, urg‘u boshida. Uchinchisi — fourteen, ya’ni 14 funt. Agar noaniq bo‘lsa, sotuvchidan so‘rang: “Sorry, sixteen or sixty?” Bu juda tabiiy, hech kim xafa bo‘lmaydi. Raqamni yozib ko‘rsatish ham yaxshi usul.
scenes.say: Sixteen pounds. Ninety pounds. Fourteen pounds.
scenes.say_uz: O‘n olti funt. To‘qson funt. O‘n to‘rt funt.

scenes.title: Yakuniy rolli o‘yin rejasi
board: 2) Say it is a bit expensive
scenes.say_native: Endi barcha o‘rganganlaringizni birlashtiramiz. Rolli o‘yin to‘rt qadamdan iborat. Birinchi: salomlashing va narxni so‘rang. Ikkinchi: narx biroz qimmat ekanini ayting. Uchinchi: o‘z narxingizni taklif qiling. To‘rtinchi: kelishing, to‘lov usulini ayting va rahmat deng. Siz ham mijoz, ham sotuvchi rolini o‘ynang, ovoz chiqarib. Agar do‘stingiz bo‘lsa, birgalikda o‘ynang.
scenes.say: Greet the seller and ask the price. Say it is a bit expensive. Make an offer. Agree, pay and say thank you.
scenes.say_uz: Sotuvchi bilan salomlashing va narxni so‘rang. Biroz qimmat ekanini ayting. Taklif bering. Kelishing, to‘lang va rahmat deng.

scenes.title: Bozorda rolli o‘yin
board: Pay by card or in cash
scenes.say_native: Rolli o‘yin boshlandi. Siz bozorda sumka sotib olmoqchisiz, uning narxi o‘ttiz funt. Siz yigirma ikki funt to‘lamoqchisiz. Ikki rolni o‘zingiz o‘ynang: mijoz va sotuvchi. Narxni so‘rang, biroz qimmat ekanini ayting, taklif bering, kelishing, to‘lov usulini tanlang va rahmat ayting. Kamida sakkizta gap ayting.
scenes.say: Now play the role-play. You want to buy a bag for thirty pounds. Offer twenty-two. Agree, pay and say thank you.
scenes.say_uz: Endi rolli o‘yinni o‘ynang. Siz o‘ttiz funtlik sumka olmoqchisiz. Yigirma ikkini taklif qiling. Kelishing, to‘lang va rahmat deng.

scenes.title: Namuna rolli o‘yin
board: How much is this bag? — Thirty pounds.
Can you do twenty-two? — I can do twenty-six.
OK, deal! Can I pay by card?
scenes.say_native: Namuna: “How much is this bag?” — “Thirty pounds.” — “That’s a bit expensive. Can you do twenty-two?” — “I can do twenty-six for you.” — “Can you do twenty-four?” — “OK, twenty-four, last price.” — “Deal! Can I pay by card?” — “Cash only, sorry.” — “No problem. Here you are.” — “Thank you, enjoy your bag!” Sizning variantingiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, muhimi qadamlar va muloyimlik.
scenes.say: How much is this bag? Thirty pounds. Can you do twenty-two? I can do twenty-six. OK, twenty-four, last price. Deal! Thank you.
scenes.say_uz: Bu sumka qancha? O‘ttiz funt. Yigirma ikkiga bera olasizmi? Yigirma oltiga bera olaman. Mayli, yigirma to‘rt, oxirgi narx. Kelishdik! Rahmat.

scenes.title: Dars xulosasi
board: Numbers: two hundred and fifty · three million
by card · in cash · Can you do £15?
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Bugun valyutalar va katta sonlarni o‘rgandik: hundred va thousand ko‘plik olmaydi. Narx haqida so‘rash va gapirish: expensive, cheap, discount va change. Naqd va karta bilan to‘lash: in cash, by card. Savdolashish iboralari: that’s a bit expensive, can you do fifteen pounds, deal. Va muhim talaffuz farqi: thirteen bilan thirty. Siz bozorga tayyorsiz!
scenes.say: Today you learned big numbers, prices, discounts, change, paying and bargaining phrases. Well done!
scenes.say_uz: Bugun siz katta sonlarni, narxlarni, chegirma va qaytimni, to‘lovni va savdolashish iboralarini o‘rgandingiz. Barakalla!

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Ask the price · offer · agree · pay
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: bozorda savdolashish bo‘yicha rolli o‘yin. Mijoz va sotuvchi rolida ovoz chiqarib, o‘zingizni yozib oling. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: kamida sakkizta gap, narxni so‘rash, biroz qimmat ekanini aytish, o‘z taklifingiz, kelishuv va to‘lov usuli. Keyingi darsda telefon, internet va ijtimoiy tarmoqlar haqida gaplashishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Homework: role-play a market bargain, record yourself. See you in the next lesson!
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: bozor savdolashuvini ijro eting va yozib oling. Keyingi darsda ko‘rishamiz!

homework_uz: Bozorda savdolashish bo‘yicha rolli o‘yinni ijro eting: mijoz va sotuvchi rolini o‘zingiz o‘ynab, o‘zingizni yozib oling. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: kamida sakkizta gap; narxni so‘rash, “a bit expensive” deyish, o‘z taklifingiz, kelishuv va to‘lov usuli (by card yoki in cash).

quiz.q: How do you say 3,000 in a price?
quiz.why_uz: Aniq son bilan thousand ko‘plik olmaydi: three thousand.
Narsa expensive bo‘ladi, narxning o‘zi esa high yoki low.

quiz.q: You want to pay with your bank card. What do you say?
options: Can I pay with cash card the?
quiz.why_uz: Karta uchun by card; so‘rash uchun Can I pay by card?

quiz.q: The coffee is £3.20 and you give £5. How much is your change?
Which phrase is polite for asking for a discount?
options: Can you give me a discount?
quiz.why_uz: Muloyim so‘rov: Can you give me a discount?

quiz.q: Which number has the stress at the end?

quiz.why_uz: Narx: four pounds fifty, pence aytilmaydi.
